story.headline: Why Fikrat DZ exists.
story.p1: Most Algerian businesses selling digital products online are running on workflows that weren't designed to scale. Orders through Facebook DMs. Payments confirmed via CCP screenshots. Delivery handled manually, one customer at a time.
story.p2: This isn't a technology problem. The technology exists. It's a local implementation problem — most software solutions aren't built around Algerian payment systems, Algerian buyer behavior, or the operational realities of running a business here.
story.p3: Fikrat DZ exists to fix that.
story.p4: We build the systems that let Algerian businesses sell professional online — with Algerian payment integration, real order management, and infrastructure that works the way your business actually works.
story.p5: We don't build generic websites. We don't use templates. Every platform we ship is built around your specific products, your workflow, and your customers.

proof.headline: We've already built it.
proof.p1: Our first project was Paradise Game DZ — one of Algeria's top gaming and mobile-services businesses, with over 50,000 Facebook followers and an active customer base.
proof.p2: We replaced their entire manual ordering workflow with a complete digital commerce platform.
proof.p3: It's live. It's processing real orders. It works.
proof.p4: Every project we take on becomes the proof that what we build is real — not a concept, not a prototype.

hero.headline: Paradise Game DZ — From Manual Ordering to a Complete Digital Commerce Platform

overview.clientBody: Paradise Game DZ is one of Algeria's established gaming and mobile-services businesses. With over 50,000 followers on Facebook and an active, loyal customer base, they had clear market presence and consistent demand for their products.
overview.problemBody: Despite strong demand, their fulfillment workflow was entirely manual. Customers browsed products on social media, then placed orders through live chat with staff. Payments were collected via CCP or Flexy and confirmed manually. Staff delivered products one by one through the same chat thread. This worked — until it didn't. As the customer base grew, the manual process created delays, errors, and a customer experience that didn't match the professionalism of the brand.

goals.orders: Centralize order management for the team

goals.visibility: Give management visibility into revenue, orders, and activity
